evidence.note: Bundestag distinguishes black-red-gold Reich colours from the black-white-red merchant flag with republican canton. Constitution entered force 14 August1919; 1920–1932 avoids transitional endpoints. Licensed graphic uses the historical 3:2 national ratio.
